# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m152 and Graphite bindings**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 upgrades to Skia milestone m152 and introduces experimental Graphite GPU backend bindings. Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn open the door to Skia's next-generation GPU backend. This release also adds a Vulkan Silk.NET package, converts all solutions to .slnx, brings FreeType-based font support to Nano Server, and lands several performance and native-leak fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upgraded to Skia milestone m152** — The bundled Skia engine is now built from the m152 branch, including an upstream chrome/m151 stability sync and the submodule/cgmanifest automation that keeps it current. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **Experimental Graphite GPU backend bindings** — New bindings expose Skia's Graphite backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a dedicated SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface gain an async RequestReadPixels API that works consistently across GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **FreeType-based font support for Nano Server** — Nano Server containers now resolve system fonts through FreeType instead of relying on unavailable Windows font APIs. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native use-after-free fixes in SKRegion and SKPixmap** — SKRegion.SpanIterator now roots its owning SKRegion, and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset / With* now root their pixel source, closing two native use-after-free paths. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak fixed in SKImage.Create failure path** — A failed raster SKImage.Create no longer leaks the unmanaged pixel buffer it had already allocated. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Several managed hot-path performance fixes** — HandleDictionary's skip-registration reflection check is now cached, SKData.SaveTo avoids a double buffer copy, GetEncodedText's null-terminated path avoids an intermediate string allocation, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its uniform lookup map. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **Windows native builds no longer pin a specific SDK version** — The Windows native build no longer pins a Windows SDK version by default, and the MSVC environment is now initialized once per native build for more reliable builds. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588), [#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with the .slnx solution conversion and the containerized test-leg infrastructure work carried over into this binding.
